lines.text: Low Tide 91.7. Sunscreen is a lifestyle.
UV index is yes. Here's more surf.
Charter report: fish not biting. Sun is.
If the bridge sways, that's the bass.

meta.notes: The DJ's chatter for Low Tide 91.7 (run W-P, maintainer 2026-10-01b: unique regional flavor everywhere), named by the station's djBarkSet.
